Chapter 1240: Chapter 3: Peeking into the Future (Please Subscribe)_2

In just hundreds of thousands or even millions of years, the Galaxy Venerate ’came back to life’ and reappeared in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

The reemerged Galaxy Venerate had already become a Thirteenth Layer time lifeform, stepping into the domain of the six Great Ancestors.

"We can’t stop him from reaching the Thirteenth Layer? Even if I personally try to kill him? The person would find a way to return? And upon returning, will have already stepped into the Thirteenth Layer?"

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun took a deep breath, feeling a slight tingling on his scalp.

So far, from the hundreds of future timelines he has observed.

Lin Yuan reaching the Thirteenth Layer is almost inevitable.

And no one can stop him, even if the Ancestor of Fierce Sun himself tries to kill the opponent, it cannot prevent him from reaching the Thirteenth Layer.

It’s merely a matter of time. If the Ancestor of Fierce Sun acts, it might delay the Galaxy Venerate’s ascension to the Thirteenth Layer by millions or tens of millions of years, that’s all.

"If nothing unexpected happens, our Fierce Sun Ancient Country is about to give birth to a time lifeform..."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun smiled. Although Lin Yuan’s almost certain future puzzled him, it was a good thing for him.

Even now, among the six Great Ancestors of this source world, there’s no peace; occasionally, there are conflicts involving future arrangements.

...

"Galaxy." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun sat cross-legged, smiling at the young Galaxy Venerate.

After seeing many of Lin Yuan’s future timelines clearly, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun basically regarded him as a peer, without any trace of his originally high and mighty demeanor.

Especially after realizing he couldn’t kill Lin Yuan, it was even more impossible to put on airs.

"Perfectly fusing two Thirteenth Layer methods, one of which is a Void Thirteenth Layer never before seen in these heavens? Galaxy, your talent is the highest I’ve seen among all beings." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun praised without holding back: "In my view, Galaxy, you will soon become the seventh Great Ancestor in these heavens. Have you thought of a name for your Ancient Country?"

"A name for my Ancient Country?" Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

He never expected the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s first words to be this.

It wasn’t surprising for Lin Yuan that the Ancestor of Fierce Sun saw through his cultivation of the "Infinite Void" inheritance, as time lifeforms below the Thirteenth Layer have no real secrets.

Lin Yuan even prepared an explanation for how he obtained the "Infinite Void" inheritance.

Yet, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun didn’t inquire about these at all.

"Ancestor..." Lin Yuan immediately said, "Creating an Ancient Country is too far-off for me."

"Right." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun nodded: "What you need to do now is to quickly reach the Thirteenth Layer and transform into a time lifeform."

"I also want to reach the Thirteenth Layer, but I’m not confident about breaking through the time loop." Lin Yuan admitted honestly.

Whether it is the Chaos Void or this Fang Yuan World, countless brilliant Twelfth Layer perfect lifeforms are trapped within the time loop.

Although Lin Yuan has meticulously planned for his ascension to the Thirteenth Layer, such as propagating the direction of Martial Arts Evolution, he still lacks confidence.

Actually, this is normal, as before breaking through to the Thirteenth Layer, no being is certain of success.

"Actually, you shouldn’t worry about these..." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun thought for a moment, looked at Lin Yuan, and said: "Just maintain a calm mind."

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The challenges presented by the time loop are unprecedented. Worrying won’t help, and maintaining a calm mindset is more suitable.

"Ancestor, about the inheritance I cultivated..." Lin Yuan wanted to explain the origin of the "Infinite Void".

"No worries."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun shook his head and said: "It’s your secret; there’s no need to explain it to me."

After speaking, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun continued: "At the Thirteenth Layer, so-called secrets mean little. The first creature born at the beginning of these heavens was named ’Abyss Dragon’."

"His talent was truly terrifying. Every particle of his body contained a vast world, enough to sweep away all powerful beings at that time with a casual move, yet ultimately, he was easily subdued by Da Fu."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at Lin Yuan.

"Abyss Dragon..."

Lin Yuan thought of the ’Dragon Abyss Blood’ he had just obtained.

From this rare treasure, he faintly perceived the terror of that original creature ’Abyss Dragon’, but now hearing the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s description, the Abyss Dragon’s fearsomess was even beyond his estimation?

At least from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s implication, is Lin Yuan’s current strength, with his internal universe coupled with the Chaotic Taiji Dao, not stronger than that Abyss Dragon?

"Of course, compared to Galaxy, the talent of Abyss Dragon is nothing."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun said.

For the Great Lord and Heavenly Venerate, talent implies bloodline, secret techniques, and many divine skills.

But for a Great Ancestor like a time lifeform, truly strong and invincible talent is the potential to step into the Thirteenth Layer.

And in this regard, who could match Lin Yuan?

"By the way, this time you came here—is it to possess?" The Ancestor of Fierce Sun seemed to recall something, smiling as he asked.

Ever since seeing Lin Yuan, he had been in shock, unexpectedly overlooking this matter for a moment.

"Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded.

This time he came to possess the Ancestor, to experience the perspective of a time lifeform.

To further accumulate his foundation for stepping into the Thirteenth Layer.

"You’re not planning to attempt the breakthrough to the Thirteenth Layer in the near future?" The Ancestor of Fierce Sun pondered for a while, then asked.

"Correct."

Lin Yuan said.

In Lin Yuan’s plan, only after his Martial Arts Evolution Road branch has completely spread across the six ancient countries of this source world, would he consider the Thirteenth Layer breakthrough.

This is the fastest scenario; it’s possible Lin Yuan might continue to wait, exploring the remaining source worlds further.

The breakthrough to the Thirteenth Layer is no small matter, presenting only two outcomes: success or becoming trapped in the time loop. Without knowing whether the Myriad Realms Gate could counter the time loop, Lin Yuan naturally should prepare as thoroughly as possible.

"I have a suggestion for you." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at Lin Yuan: "It’s just a suggestion, of course."

"Please, Ancestor, tell me." Lin Yuan immediately responded, his expression solemn.

Any advice personally given by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun was certainly worth attentive listening.

"With your foundation and accumulation, there’s no need to possess so soon. Wait until before attempting the Thirteenth Layer breakthrough to possess." The Ancestor of Fierce Sun advised.

Many Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country have exchanged for multiple possession opportunities, but Lin Yuan is different; early or repeated possession could actually affect him.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Though he didn’t understand why the Ancestor of Fierce Sun made such a suggestion, Lin Yuan trusted there must be specific reasons and he should just heed the advice.

"However, Ancestor, about the billion merits I exchanged..." Lin Yuan couldn’t help but ask.

Before coming, he had used a billion merits for the exchange.

"A billion merits?" The Ancestor of Fierce Sun grinned: "When you return, you can choose freely among the many guidance inheritors in the treasure trove without spending any merits."

"Thank you, Ancestor."

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened.

Previously, he had been torn about which two of the six supreme inheritances to choose—after all, with the three billion merits, after deducting the one billion for possession, he could only exchange for two. But now, with the Ancestor’s words, the entire treasure trove of the Ancient Country became entirely accessible to Lin Yuan.

"Ancestor... Do you know my chances of reaching the Thirteenth Layer in the future?" Before leaving, Lin Yuan asked this question.

As a time lifeform, the Ancestor should be aware of Lin Yuan’s chances to break into the Thirteenth Layer, having observed future timelines.

"The possibility of reaching the Thirteenth Layer..."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at Lin Yuan. Almost every Peak Venerable who comes for possession asks this question.

And typically, the Ancestor’s response is mainly encouragement because those Peak Venerates have very slim chances of reaching the Thirteenth Layer; it would take countless observations of many trillions of timelines to find a successful path.

But facing Lin Yuan’s inquiry,

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun, after a brief contemplation, said: "Very high."
